pairs: Obsecro itaque vos fratres per misericordiam Dei,
And so, I beg you, brothers,
ut exhibeatis corpora vestra hostiam viventem,
by the mercy of God, that you offer your bodies as a living sacrifice,
with the subservience of your mind.
And do not choose to be conformed to this age,
sed reformamini in novitate sensus vestri:
but instead choose to be reformed in the newness of your mind,
ut probetis quæ sit voluntas Dei bona,
so that you may demonstrate what is the will of God: what is good,
Dico enim per gratiam quæ data est mihi,
through the grace that has been given to me,
non plus sapere quam oportet sapere,
to all who are among you:
Taste no more than it is necessary to taste,
et unicuique sicut Deus divisit mensuram fidei.
but taste unto sobriety and just as God has distributed a share of the faith to each one.
Sicut enim in uno corpore multa membra habemus,
For just as, within one body, we have many parts,
omnia autem membra non eumdem actum habent:
though all the parts do not have the same role,
ita multi unum corpus sumus in Christo,
so also we, being many, are one body in Christ,
and each one is a part, the one of the other.
And we each have different gifts,
according to the grace that has been given to us:
in agreement with the reasonableness of faith;
or he who teaches, in doctrine;
he who shows mercy, in cheerfulness.
loving one another with fraternal charity,
in the difficulties of the saints, sharing;
Bless those who are persecuting you:
Rejoice with those who are rejoicing.
Weep with those who are weeping.
Be of the same mind toward one another:
Do not choose to seem wise to yourself.
Render to no one harm for harm.
providentes bona non tantum coram Deo,
Provide good things, not only in the sight of God,
but also in the sight of all men.
in so far as you are able,
be at peace with all men.
Do not defend yourselves, dearest ones. Instead,
I shall give retribution, says the Lord.”
So if an enemy is hungry,
carbones ignis congeres super caput ejus.
you will heap burning coals upon his head.
Do not allow evil to prevail,
instead prevail over evil by means of goodness.
